evidence_quotes.quote: Mac mini (2024, M4): Idle power consumption 4 W (14 BTU/h); CPU Max power consumption 65 W (222 BTU/h), measured directly from wall AC source.
Mac mini (M4): Height 5.0 cm (2.0 in), Width 12.7 cm (5.0 in), Depth 12.7 cm (5.0 in), Weight 0.67 kg (1.5 lbs); 100-240V AC 50/60Hz, 155W maximum continuous power.
Acoustic performance (ECMA-109): Sound pressure level (operator position) 4 dBA at idle and 4 dBA on wireless web; 1GbE standard (configurable to 10GbE).

adversarial_checks: Power hierarchy & PSU headroom verified: Distinguished 65 W official M4 CPU Max wall load (used for realistic TCO peak) from the 155 W internal PSU ceiling shared with Thunderbolt 4 bus-powered peripherals (4 <= 22 <= 65 W).

Acoustic bound compliance check: Apple's ECMA-109 4 dBA idle floor is below the 15 dBA schema lower bound, so noise_idle_dba is set to null while documenting 4 dBA idle explicitly in key_specs_kv alongside 35.4 dBA measured active load.

SM-02 & Korea 220V check: Confirmed US MSRP $599 (MU9D3LL/A) vs KR official 890,000 KRW (MU9D3KH/A) under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null, and verified internal 100-240V PSU uses a detachable IEC C7 220V cord.
